payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all possible splits of k coins between armor and weapon upgrades (0 to k) and check win condition using ceiling to account for turns.
payload.rationale: The solution scans all i from 0 to k, checking if the character can win with i armor upgrades and k-i weapon upgrades. This is an exhaustive search over upgrade allocations, closest to backtracking among given subtypes.
